description.value: You can spend a minor action to Assist a creature. Additionally, you can choose to @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.018XFM2VDH6HIHL0]{Glorify} or @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.018XFM2VDH6HIHL0]{Vilify} a creature as part of the same minor action, paying the usual cost.
